# RunnerUp — India's Premier Virtual Running & Marathon Platform

> RunnerUp is India's leading GPS-verified virtual running, cycling, and walking platform. Runners participate from anywhere across India at their own pace, log activities via Strava, Garmin, NRC, or smartwatches, and receive authentic heavy metal 3D finisher medals, DRI-FIT t-shirts, and instant QR-verified E-Certificates delivered to their doorstep with 100% free shipping across all 19,000+ Indian pincodes.

## Quick Facts
- **Website:** https://runnerup.in
- **Headquarters:** India (Pan-India Service)
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5.0 (over 1,840 verified runner reviews)
- **Supported Apps:** Strava, Garmin Connect, Nike Run Club (NRC), Adidas Running, Apple Watch / Apple Fitness, Samsung Health, Google Fit, Coros, Suunto, and Treadmill console photo.
- **Event Distances:**
  - 1.5 KM & 3 KM (Starter, Kids & Walking)
  - 5 KM / 5K (Fun Run & Beginners)
  - 10 KM / 10K (Endurance Challenge)
  - 21 KM / 21K (Half Marathon)
  - Virtual Cycling & Step Walking Challenges
- **Finisher Rewards:** Heavy 3D die-cast embossed metal finisher medal, premium DRI-FIT running t-shirt, instant QR-coded verified digital certificate, and personalized runner bib.
- **Shipping:** 100% free express delivery across India (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kochi, and all 28 states).
- **Customer Support:** WhatsApp: +91-8287831071 | Email: runnerupofficials@gmail.com

## Key Pages & Resources
- [Browse Upcoming Running Events](https://runnerup.in/events): Full catalogue of upcoming and live virtual marathons, 5K, 10K, and 21K races in India.
- [What is a Virtual Run?](https://runnerup.in/what-is-virtual-run): Comprehensive guide explaining how virtual marathons work, step-by-step registration, GPS tracking submission, and reward dispatch.
- [National Leaderboard](https://runnerup.in/leaderboard): Live GPS-verified finish times, runner rankings, pace, and race leaderboards.
- [Finisher Gallery](https://runnerup.in/gallery): Real runner photos, unboxing moments, and medal showcases from participants across India.
- [Prize & Medal Tracking](https://runnerup.in/prize): Track medal dispatch status, certificate downloads, and kit delivery using Bib number or registered phone/email.
- [Online Registration](https://runnerup.in/register): Fast registration form with instant UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM) and card payment support.
- [About RunnerUp](https://runnerup.in/about): Company mission, athlete community stories, and standards for GPS verification.

## How It Works in 3 Simple Steps
1. **Register Online:** Choose your challenge and distance on https://runnerup.in/events. Fill in your delivery details and complete entry.
2. **Run Anywhere & Track:** Run anytime within the event window outdoors or on a treadmill using any fitness app (Strava, Garmin, NRC, etc.).
3. **Upload Proof & Get Rewarded:** Upload your activity screenshot in your RunnerUp dashboard. Receive instant verified E-Certificate and your physical heavy metal finisher medal delivered to your doorstep.
